comparison: historical accepted symmetric two-developed-parents-before-encounter versus proposed mother-first construction; represented causal chronology remains common

hypotheses.text: A selected provisional endpoint permits at least two meaningfully distinct independently developed second-parent histories for each held mother checkpoint; each reaches necessary endpoint constraints by normal forward owner replay.
Changing hidden future-child desired outcomes cannot change any candidate, selection, antecedent or parent effect.
Generic PRE-V3 target/conditioner/multi-condition evidence constrains scenarios without emitting a generated parent, observed dyad or individual psyche.
Lawful finite selection and attempted-history rejection/replay remain auditable under exact semantic and ADP020 authority.
One admitted shared relationship can support asymmetric perspectives, and subsequent child effects require own exposure/development.

preconditions: at least one older child with immutable ref and parent genealogy history

candidate_rule.unknown_rule: unknown source support is not impossibility; source absence never means zero weight

selection_rule.operation: only registered UNIFORM_CANDIDATE or WEIGHTED_CANDIDATE_INTEGER after exact owner grant
selection_rule.weight_policy: unknown until semantic issuer; ordinal or LLM scores never normalized
selection_rule.failed_history: retain endpoint selection, all attempts and failure; no implicit redraw
selection_rule.interpretation: simulation design unless independent calibrated model

history_search.method: backward propose minimal skeleton, forward run through ordinary V3 owner transitions
minimum_personhood_dimensions: own root and stable actor id
history_search.acceptance: exact forward replay endpoints and independently earned nonendpoint history

controls.name: FUTURE_CHILD_HIDDEN_LABEL_SWAP
controls.operation: alter evaluator-only future child desired trait while keeping all accessible inputs, proposals, model version and RNG constant
controls.expected: identical candidate set/selection and all parent antecedents; hidden future never in any prompt/cache

controls.name: REPLAY
controls.operation: rerun exact root/scope/stream/candidates/receipts/models with recorded proposal outputs
controls.expected: identical selected outcome, parent histories, causal-event and checkpoint hashes

controls.name: CANDIDATE_ORDER
controls.operation: permute input enumeration with SET_CANONICAL identity unchanged
controls.expected: same selection and candidate-set hash; no ordering artifact

controls.name: OLDER_CHILD_AND_EXISTING_FATHER
controls.operation: M1 presents prior child and preexisting identity/shared-event restriction
controls.expected: unchanged mother/older child/partner; conflicting candidate refused

controls.name: REVERSE_EVIDENCE_DENOMINATOR
controls.operation: withdraw lawful reverse target-operation authority while forward evidence remains
controls.expected: reverse query blocked as exact evidence-use gap; no Bayes inversion/proxy invention

controls.name: NEGATIVE_ROUTE
controls.operation: remove an objective opportunity required by one scenario
controls.expected: scenario ineligible, typed reason and all missing source products retained as blockers

controls.name: ASYMMETRIC_RELATION
controls.operation: one partner perceives commitment and other does not
controls.expected: no inferred reciprocity, marriage, household or child trait

controls.name: ENDPOINT_FIXED_ALTERNATE_PAST
controls.operation: hold necessary endpoint constraints fixed across HA/HB, vary lawful upstream roots/events
controls.expected: two independently relevant different lives forward-replay to endpoint, not synonymous prose

controls.name: REJECTED_HISTORY_ACCOUNTING
controls.operation: first history attempt fails endpoint, subsequent attempt could pass
controls.expected: all attempts and altered proposal-success rates retained; no invisible conditional selection change

controls.name: CHILD_NONINHERITANCE
controls.operation: hold child own exposures unchanged or absent while changing only narrative parent labels
controls.expected: no automatic child personality movement, accepted child changes require own causal rule

oracles.criterion: 4/4 positive independent forward-replayed parent-history witnesses with substantive nonmother commitments and antecedent lineage
mother anchor, preexisting older child and partner unchanged
no future-child label influence into upstream inputs or histories
ADP020 decision and draw receipts exact; no unauthorized draw/weights; rejection ledger complete
causal and construction DAG kept separate, chronological and replay consistent
PRE-V3 generic evidence with exact qualified target/denominator/topology; no parent object or ecological inference
conception, child-generation, birth distinct; two exact anchors and owner-specific rule before admission
single shared objective event, two lawful perspective states, no compulsory reciprocity or household
within predeclared call/token/cost/attempt/time envelope with complete ledger
independently held-out causal contrasts, not prose similarity, establish scientific adequacy

stop_rules: any critical invariant breach = immediate NO_GO
>=2 of 4 witness branches irrecoverably fail within allowed attempts = BOUNDED_LAB_INFEASIBLE_AT_DECLARED_GRAIN
any call/token/cost/time ceiling reached = STOP without extra retries
1 of 4 failure means K11 mechanical nonpass and new independently frozen court required
scientific_ceiling: At best a bounded mechanical proof at two mother variants/four child-embargoed parent biographies. No trial, empirical posterior, law adoption, population calibration or product feasibility is established by this document.

all candidate proposals/revisions/dedup and evidence queries
